Craft an Enchanting Table, then record it with a Totem guide or a book.
advancements.deadrecall.enchanting_manua: Use a guide or book on an Enchanting Table to obtain the Enchanting method guide.
book.deadrecall.enchanting_manual.title: Enchanting Method Guide
book.deadrecall.enchanting_manual.page.1:
POWER

Place Chiseled Bookshelves in valid vanilla shelf positions. Normal books add 1 power; enchanted books add their total enchantment levels.
book.deadrecall.enchanting_manual.page.2:
QUALITY

Valid shelves combine up to 64 power. Keep air between shelf and table. Higher power improves candidates without bypassing vanilla compatibility.
